headline: Expanded databases map RNA 3D structures, viral protein folds and protein domain families
label: Structural And Annotation Reference Databases
summary: Recent releases expand structure and annotation resources for RNA, viral proteins, endogenous retroviruses and conserved protein domains.
synthesis: The four items are curated reference resources that consolidate structural or annotation data into maintained collections. RR3DD 2.0 classifies 15,764 RNA 3D structure chains into 1,042 clusters by RMscore and maps them to Rfam. BFVD v3 provides ColabFold-AlphaFold2 predicted structures for viral proteins as a structural atlas. ERV Navigator integrates human endogenous retrovirus annotations, nomenclatures and genomic loci within a phylogenetically informed framework. The NCBI Conserved Domain Database 2026 update describes revised domain and family models, curation, precomputed annotations and search services. The shared element is infrastructure for structural and evolutionary annotation rather than a single method. Each resource targets a different molecular class, and the new content lies in expanded coverage and integration with existing classifications such as Rfam and established endogenous retrovirus nomenclature.
